_comment: ShellTerra MissionHillsActivities seed data. Shell: MissionHillsActivities. Times are San Diego local, 24h, no timezone suffix. kind is 'activity'. Sources: Mission Hills Business Improvement District events page (missionhillsbid.com), Mission Hills Town Council events section (missionhillstowncouncil.org), and Eventbrite, all scraped September 11, 2026. COORDINATES: every Eventbrite-sourced item carries Eventbrite's own geocoded lat/lng and is trustworthy; the four non-Eventbrite items (three MHTC meetings and Shop Small) still carry estimated coords and are flagged below. Eventbrite's 'Mission Hills' pages are San Diego-wide, not neighborhood-scoped: 970 listings were pulled across 49 pages and filtered to 92103 Mission Hills street addresses, which left 12. Near-misses are in _out_of_area.
_shellId: TODO - create the Mission Hills shell in Appwrite and paste its ID here before seeding
_verify_before_running: SHELL_ID in .env must be the Mission Hills shell ID, NOT the Gaslamp ID 6a966244cb2082796b17

Coordinates on the 12 Eventbrite items come from Eventbrite's own geocoder and replaced earlier hand estimates. The four non-Eventbrite items (mhtc-town-hall, both mhtc-board-meeting entries, mission-hills-small-business-saturday) still have ESTIMATED coords - verify those four pins only
Safdie Rabines Architects address (925 Fort Stockton Dr) and Francis Parker Lower School address (4201 Randolph St) are mine; MHTC publishes venue names only
AI & Tea Salon is dated Sep 11 2026 on its event page but the search card said 'Tomorrow'. Either way it is now past. Confirm whether it is a recurring salon before dropping it
Small Business Saturday date (Nov 28, 2026) is derived from Thanksgiving falling on Nov 26, 2026; the BID page gives no date. Hours 10:00-18:00 are a PLACEHOLDER
Categories 'community', 'wellness' and 'dating' are new and do not appear in the Gaslamp seed file. Confirm the seeder and app accept them, or remap

CONTENT REVIEW: six of the sixteen items are dating or tantra events at Radiance Yoga and Communion. That is a heavy skew for a neighborhood shell. Decide how many belong in a public feed before seeding
Descriptions on Eventbrite-sourced items are organizer marketing copy, lightly cleaned. Rewrite in ShellTerra's voice before they go live
Radiance Yoga (1612 W Lewis St) appears under two Eventbrite venue spellings with slightly different coords. Pick one canonical venue record
No 'yearly' recurrence example exists in the Gaslamp file, so annual events are not seeded as recurring series
MHTC meeting series is 2nd Thursday monthly at 18:00. Only Oct/Nov/Dec 2026 are published. Do not extrapolate into 2027 - they go dark some months

_deferred._why: Mission Hills events referenced on the BID or Town Council sites without a confirmed forward date and time. Do not paste into items[] until a real start date and time is in hand.

taste-of-mission-hills.title: Taste of Mission Hills
taste-of-mission-hills.status: Annual October food walk and the BID's main fundraiser. Ticket includes Old Town Trolley transport along a 5+ mile route covering West Lewis St, Ft. Stockton Dr, Goldfinch St, West Washington St, Reynard Way, and India St. The BID page says 2026 plans are underway but publishes no date and no ticket link. Highest-value Mission Hills item once dated. Watch missionhillsbid.com or join their mailing list.

mhtc-4th-of-july.title: Mission Hills 4th of July Parade and Concert
mhtc-4th-of-july.status: MHTC's signature annual community event. Costume and decorated bike/wagon parade through Mission Hills ending at Pioneer Park, with prizes for Best Costume and Best Bike/Wagon decor, then games and live music through the afternoon while families picnic. Residents head to neighborhood vista points for bay fireworks at night. The MHTC schedule block reads 'No upcoming events found' and publishes no times. Date is fixed (July 4, 2027) but start times are unknown.

mhtc-concerts-in-the-park.title: Mission Hills Concerts in the Park
mhtc-concerts-in-the-park.status: Annual summer series on Fridays at Pioneer Park, currently in its 31st season. Picnic-basket format. The lineup block reads 'No upcoming events found', so the 2026 season has ended and 2027 dates are not posted. Once dated this is a strong weekly recurring series for the shell, same shape as the Gaslamp weekly residencies.

mission-hills-5k.title: Mission Hills 5K Run/Walk
mission-hills-5k.status: Annual 5K benefiting Grant TK-8 through the Grant School Community Foundation, over $200,000 raised to date. The 2026 race (11th annual) ran Saturday March 21, 2026 at 08:00 and its results and photos are posted. CAUTION: missionhills5k.com still displays the March 21 date as if upcoming, but that is stale 2026 copy - March 21 is not a Saturday in 2027. Wait for the real 2027 date.

halloween-in-the-hills.title: Halloween in the Hills
halloween-in-the-hills.status: Block party on the West Lewis Street Shopping District with live music, shopping, and food trucks. Referenced on the MHTC special events page but with no date, and its only 'more info' link points to Instagram rather than a listing. Likely late October 2026, so this one is worth chasing now. Check @missionhillssd or the West Lewis merchants directly.

holiday-in-the-hills.title: Holiday in the Hills
holiday-in-the-hills.status: Companion block party to Halloween in the Hills on West Lewis Street, same format - live music, shopping, food trucks. No date published on the MHTC site. Likely early December 2026. Same chase as above.

colors-on-canvas-banner-contest.title: Colors on Canvas - Banner Art Contest
colors-on-canvas-banner-contest.status: Annual BID banner art contest. Students at Grant UTK8 School paint local Mission Hills businesses onto seventy 30x94 inch banners installed throughout the neighborhood, with Artist in Residence Sarah Ekedal. The 2027 edition is 'launching soon' with no date. This is a multi-week program, not a single evening, so once the banners are installed it may fit better as a landmark series or timemarks than as an activity.

mission-hills-progressive-summer-mixer.title: Mission Hills Progressive Summer Mixer
mission-hills-progressive-summer-mixer.status: 2026 edition ran Wednesday June 24, 2026, 17:30-19:00 at 325 W Washington St. Already passed. Annual, so expect a late-June 2027 date.

mission-hills-community-garage-sale.title: Mission Hills Community Garage Sale
mission-hills-community-garage-sale.status: 2026 edition ran Saturday May 16, 2026 starting at 08:00, sponsored by Maureen Tess Fieberg and Antoinette Embry. Already passed. Annual, expect mid-May 2027. Neighborhood-wide with no single venue, so it needs a pin decision when seeded.

mission-hills-spring-business-mixer.title: Mission Hills Spring Business Mixer
mission-hills-spring-business-mixer.status: 2026 edition ran Wednesday March 18, 2026, 17:30-19:00 at US Bank, paired with that branch's grand re-opening. Already passed. The mixer looks annual but the US Bank tie-in was one-time, so the 2027 venue will differ.

mhtc-quarterly-member-meetings.title: MHTC Quarterly Member Meetings
mhtc-quarterly-member-meetings.status: MHTC states it holds quarterly meetings for all members and interested parties in addition to monthly Board of Trustees meetings. The October 8 Town Hall in items[] may be one of these. No separate quarterly schedule is published, so the rest cannot be seeded.

items.title: AI & Tea Salon
items.description: An evening of open discussion about artificial intelligence, held over a curated tea service at The Den in Mission Hills. No slides, no pitch, no panel, just a hosted conversation about what AI means for work, creativity, relationships, and how we make sense of things. The group is capped deliberately to keep the conversation real.

items.title: 2nd Annual Mission Hills Oktoberfest
items.description: Oktoberfest in Pioneer Park hosted by the Grant School Community Foundation, the same group behind the Mission Hills 5K. Family fun, entertainment, crafts, food, and a Dachshund race. Headliner is Sauer Sam & the Tablecloth Band. Ticketing runs from General Admission up through Biergarten Chic, Rustic Comfort, and Luxury table tiers, so this is a fundraiser format rather than a drop-in street festival. No refunds.

items.title: Birth Partner Coaching: A Birth Rehearsal Workshop
items.description: A four-hour workshop at Radiance Yoga on West Lewis for expecting couples. Where most childbirth classes teach what happens during labor, this one has partners practice what to do: how to move, breathe, and work through birth together. Run by Nirvana.
items.address: 1612 West Lewis Street, San Diego, CA 92103

items.title: Intelligent Singles Mixer on Rooftop in San Diego
items.description: Meet San Diego singles for a fun night out where rooftop views make conversation easy.
items.address: 901 West Washington Street #Suite 801, San Diego, CA 92103

items.title: 300 Hour Yoga Teacher Training
items.description: Advanced teacher training at Yoga One on Fort Stockton, open to people who already hold a 200-hour yoga teaching certificate. Taught by their in-house team. This is a certification program rather than a drop-in class, so the Eventbrite date is the start of a longer commitment.
items.address: 1920 Fort Stockton Drive, San Diego, CA 92103

items.title: Mission Hills Town Council - Town Hall Meeting
items.description: Open town hall run by the Mission Hills Town Council. Larger and more public-facing than the monthly trustees meetings, held at Francis Parker Lower School rather than the usual venue. This is where neighborhood issues get raised directly with the council. Guests are welcome; you do not need to be a member to attend. MHTC standing committees cover Membership and Publicity, Finance, Elections and Bylaws, and the Washington Street Maintenance Assessment District, with special committees for Beautification, Events, and Safety.

items.title: Tantra Date Night for Couples
items.description: A guided evening workshop for couples at Radiance Yoga on West Lewis, run by The Heart Centered Being. Part of an ongoing San Diego series. Ticketed, partner required.
items.address: 1612 W Lewis St, San Diego, CA 92103

items.title: Speed Dating Beyond Small Talk - Tantra Speed Date
items.description: An experiment in chemistry and connection beyond small talk. More than speed dating.
items.address: 1612 W Lewis St, San Diego, CA 92103

items.title: San Diego Halloween Film Festival
items.description: Halloween night at Cinema Under the Stars on Goldfinch, Mission Hills' outdoor screening venue. A catered costume party built around a curated lineup of independent horror shorts and features from local and national filmmakers. There is a Crimson Carpet on the way in and candlelight seating under the open sky. Presented by San Diego Citizens. One night only.

items.title: Breath & Embodiment: A Somatic Reset
items.description: A somatic reset through breathwork, music and movement. Release tension, clear emotion, return to center.
items.address: 1612 West Lewis Street, San Diego, CA 92103

items.title: Mission Hills Town Council - Board of Trustees Meeting
items.description: Monthly Board of Trustees meeting for the Mission Hills Town Council, held on the second Thursday at Safdie Rabines Architects. Guests are welcome. This is where the council works through neighborhood projects, city requests, and committee business. If you want to know what is actually happening in Mission Hills before it is announced, this is the room.
items.address: 925 Fort Stockton Dr, San Diego, CA 92103

items.title: Shop Small in Mission Hills - Small Business Saturday
items.description: Mission Hills businesses along Washington St, Goldfinch St, and India St participate in Small Business Saturday, the kickoff to holiday shopping at independent shops. The BID promotes it every year as a neighborhood-wide push rather than a single-venue event. Roughly two thirds of every dollar spent at a small business stays in the local community. Follow @missionhillssd on Instagram for the day's special offers, which the BID posts rather than listing on their site.
items.address: W Washington St and Goldfinch St, San Diego, CA 92103

items.title: Warren Miller Ski Night 2026
items.description: 3rd annual Warren Miller ski night at Cinema Under the Stars, sponsored by EXCELSA. Details to come.

_out_of_area._why: Listings that surfaced on Eventbrite's 'Mission Hills, San Diego' page but are NOT in Mission Hills. Recorded so they are not mistakenly re-added on a future scrape. Eventbrite's neighborhood pages are metro-wide, so every listing needs its street address checked against 92103 before it goes in items[].

9d-breathwork-mission-hills-venue.title: 9D Breathwork San Diego
9d-breathwork-mission-hills-venue.reason: Venue is literally named 'Mission Hills Venue' but sits at 1919 San Diego Avenue, 92110, which is Old Town. The name is a trap. Sat Sep 19, 10:30-12:00. Belongs in an Old Town shell.

wellness-market-eve-radd.title: Wellness Market San Diego
wellness-market-eve-radd.reason: At EVE at RaDD Waterfront downtown, not Mission Hills. Sun Sep 13, 11:00-16:00. Would belong to a downtown or Embarcadero shell.

eventbrite-metro-remainder.title: The other 958 Eventbrite listings
eventbrite-metro-remainder.reason: The full crawl of Eventbrite's Mission Hills pages returned 970 San Diego listings across 49 pages. After filtering to 92103 Mission Hills street addresses only 12 survived. The rest were bucketed by address into Gaslamp Quarter (159), Pacific Beach (59), La Jolla (47), North Park (35), Ocean Beach (23), Little Italy (20), El Cajon Boulevard (17), Hillcrest (15) and Old Town (12), with the remainder outside these districts or online-only. Those buckets are extracted and ready to become their own seed files.
